commit_message: 🧪 [testing improvement] Add missing tests for supportsActivityType
title: 🧪 [testing improvement] Add missing tests for supportsActivityType
description:
🎯 **What:** The testing gap addressed
The `supportsActivityType` platform logic in `utils/achievement-share.ts` was lacking test coverage. This function utilizes `react-native` `Platform` module specifically branching on iOS and non-iOS OS strings, and performing an array match.

📊 **Coverage:** What scenarios are now tested
We implemented a mock pattern inside `utils/__tests__/achievement-share.test.ts` that temporarily overwrites `Platform.OS` natively. This test checks non-iOS branches and correctly verifies arrays of both supported and unsupported `com.apple.UIKit.activity` types during iOS simulations.

✨ **Result:** The improvement in test coverage
The test coverage allows future regressions when altering either supported platform activity strings or internal branch conditions to be captured.
